scope: ordinary terminal transition and explicit bonus test control

reproduction.expected: The next unlocked level starts; the current level is not replayed.
reproduction.reported: The current level restarts instead of advancing.

acceptance: A terminal normal tap advances to level N+1 when one exists.
Replay remains available through its dedicated button.
A visibly labeled test button enters the bonus course once without changing the real gameplay route.
Normal player actions remain the only route to the production bonus gate.
